Travel to <DST> in the <DSY> system, land there to pickup the <CT>, and return to the Academy. You have one month to complete this mission and it pays 10,000 credits. Remember to stop to refuel when necessary. One of our Academy training Overseers will be following you all the way. If you need help, hail him by targeting his ship and pressing the "Y" key (unless changed in preferences). Press "Greetings" and he will assist you. Good luck.
